name: sprite-animation-pack
description: Turn a character's animation frames — a folder of PNGs or a whole sprite sheet — into a game-ready animation pack: actions grouped automatically, every frame lined up on the feet (or kept in place), frame timing and loops, a uniform-cell atlas PNG, Aseprite/Phaser JSON, a Godot 4 SpriteFrames .tres and Unity slicing notes. Preview each action with onion skin and nudge frames pixel by pixel. Runs locally; no API keys.

description_i18n.en: Turn a character's animation frames — a folder of PNGs or a whole sprite sheet — into a game-ready animation pack: actions grouped automatically, every frame lined up on the feet (or kept in place), frame timing and loops, a uniform-cell atlas PNG, Aseprite/Phaser JSON, a Godot 4 SpriteFrames .tres and Unity slicing notes. Preview each action with onion skin and nudge frames pixel by pixel. Runs locally; no API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把角色的动作帧（一文件夹 PNG 或一整张精灵图）整理成游戏可直接用的动作包：自动按动作分组，所有帧按脚底对齐（或保持原位），设置帧时长和循环，导出等格图集 PNG、Aseprite/Phaser JSON、Godot 4 SpriteFrames .tres 和 Unity 切片说明。面板里逐个动作播放预览，带洋葱皮，可逐像素微调。在本地运行，无需 API 密钥。
